title: Plato's cave: someone outside the cave pulling us through

tellings.quote: like it would seem there has to be somebody outside of the cave doing this. Like there has somebody has to from the perspective of enlightenment be pulling us through.

plain: In the ancient Greek philosopher Plato's book The Republic, people trapped in a cave mistake shadows for reality until one is led out into the light, and the philosopher James Madden argues that for anyone to be led out, "there has to be somebody outside of the cave" pulling us through toward enlightenment. Madden offers this as his own reading of Plato and of Plato's teacher Socrates, in an episode linking the cave to UFOs and consciousness. If he is right, waking up would never be something people do alone, but something done to them from outside.
